jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. closing.From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, implementation success* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoptionWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in transformation programs* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environmentAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. jobs.description: Process Operator (f/m/d)Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, GermanyStart date: ASAPContract type: Full-timeAbout usWe’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.The roleIn this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.Your main tasks- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they ariseYour profile- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style- Interest in food production and fermentation processes- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor- Basic working knowledge of EnglishNice to have- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines- Basic working knowledge of GermanWhat we offer- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities- 28 days of paid holiday per year- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleaguesHow to applyA short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

jobs.description: teamZUKUNFT gGmbHteamZUKUNFT gGmbH is a recognized provider of independent youth welfare services in accordance with §75 SGB VIII and has been supporting children, young people and families in challenging life situations for many years. With a wide range of inpatient and outpatient educational support, equestrian education and therapy, and targeted time-out measures, we respond individually to the needs of our clients. Our portfolio is complemented by experiential education programs for children and young people, such as school trips, day programs for schools, and supervised holiday camps. We work flexibly, according to need, and always with the aim of empowering young people and positively supporting their development.Daily BusinessThe teamZUKUNFT gGmbH is offering dedicated students a scholarship program in Germany. This scholarship program is a unique opportunity for you to pursue a fully funded degree in Social Work at IU International University.  As an independent provider of youth welfare, we run residential groups for children and youth in Düsseldorf, Wermelskirchen, Hilden and Angelburg. These residential communities are social-educational. With us you will find a varied and dynamic work environment. - Child and youth welfare - Supporting the independent living of our clients and working with intensive pedagogical group homes - Outpatient support such as social-pedagogical family assistance, educational mentoring and time-out measures- Experiential educational offerings such as school trips and holiday campsDeine Skills- German language level: B2- Entrance requirement (certified, notarized translation in German or English) - National vocational qualification - A structured, self-responsible way of working, as well as a strong communication personality- Willingness to take over work at weekends and flexible working arrangements- High motivation, teamwork, empathy and creativity are our basic requirementsDeine Benefits- Possibility to study at a local university- Payment of tuition fees - Free national public transport ticket and German courses - Monthly salary starting from 500 EUR (possible promotion) - Advanced vocational education- State-Recognized qualification (social worker)- Free communal residence room in Cologne, Düsseldorf and its environsWe look forward to receiving your detailed and compelling application documents. jobs.occupation: Senior Governance und Change Manager (f/m/d) (Change-Manager/in)
jobs.description: E.ON Energy Markets GmbH (EEM) is a subsidiary of the E.ON Group based in Essen. We provide the E.ON Group’s regional business units with access to wholesale energy markets and manage the associated opportunities and risks. Our expertise spans portfolio strategies, risk management and data-driven services. Working across several European countries, we connect regional business needs with European energy markets.At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.Ready to become a Playmaker? Join our team and apply online. Are you brave enough to forge new paths and create a real impact? We can't wait to meet you. It's on us to make new energy work.What You Will Own Governance and Change Management - Own and continuously evolve the EMDT change management process within our SAFe/DevOps approach - Drive improvements to governance, efficiency and delivery quality across the change lifecycle and ensure transparency across decisions, priorities, dependencies and organizational risks. Establish governance mechanisms that balance agility, quality and operational stability while adapting to AI-native product DevOps. - Close collaboration with Energy Markets Business  Performance Management and Leadership Support Own the preparation, coordination and continuous improvement of Performance Dialogues for EMDT and work closely with the digital leadership team to transform operational data management insights and prepare respective decision-ready content.  - Challenge assumptions, identify root causes and help ensure that actions result in measurable outcomes. - Track commitments, actions and outcomes to strengthen accountability across the organization.  Operational Strategy Alignment - Support the consolidation of product and domain-level strategies into a coherent operational target picture for Digital Technology. - Work closely with Enterprise Architects, Domain Leads and Product Teams to identify synergies, dependencies and alignment opportunities. - Facilitate cross-domain discussions and help ensure consistent execution against agreed priorities. - Maintain transparency on strategic progress, risks and interdependencies.  Cross-Functional Management and Disaster Recovery - Drive initiatives across teams (Product teams, Finance, Strategy) with different objectives, priorities and perspectives. - Lead activities related to Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Management. This includes ensuring that recovery objectives, documentation and governance requirements are understood, maintained and monitored, as well as supporting the identification and resolution of recovery gaps. - Contribute to the further development of resilience capabilities as an increasingly important pillar of Energy Markets Digital Technologies’ operational excellence.  What We Are Looking For Required - 10+ years of experience in IT governance, organizational effectiveness, operational excellence, transformation or comparable roles with a minimum of 5 years experience in C-level stakeholder management - Knowledge of Energy Markets, Energy Trading and Trading Technologies - Strong hands-on knowledge of AI technologies und tools, familiarity with AI-native product development - High degree of resilience, ownership and organizational awareness. - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate complex situations into structured decisions processes and actions. - Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), facilitation and stakeholder management skills  Preferred - Strong understanding of software delivery organizations - Experience in collaborating with architects, developers as well as financial and business analyst functions. - Understanding of IT-Infrastructure, Business Continuity Management and Disaster Recovery concepts.  - Experience preparing senior management material and facilitating decision-making processes.  What Success Looks Like You will help build a Digital Technology organization that is: Transparent in its governance. Efficient in its execution. Accountable in its delivery. Resilient in its operations. And continuously improving in the way it manages change. You will be recognized as a trusted partner who enables leaders and teams to focus on delivering value by creating clarity, driving accountability and helping turn strategic ambition into operational reality.
